footnote.helpText: Cmd/Ctrl + Enter to insert · Esc to cancel
footnote.title: Footnote
footnote.description: Footnote text appears at the foot of the page on the same sheet as the marker — for asides the reader needs on the same page as the line that prompted them.
footnote.placeholder: e.g. See Smith 2019, p. 142, for the original formulation.

endnote.helpText: Cmd/Ctrl + Enter to insert · Esc to cancel
endnote.title: Endnote
endnote.description: Endnote text collects under Notes at the end of the manuscript — for sourcing, citations, and longer remarks.
endnote.placeholder: e.g. The name 'Eleanor' surfaces across the archive in nine distinct hands.

mermaid.title: Mermaid diagram
mermaid.description: Write a Mermaid diagram spec. It will render in-line where the cursor sits.
mermaid.placeholder: graph TD; A[Manuscript] --> B{Reviewed?}; B -->|Yes| C[Publish]; B -->|No| D[Revise]; D --> A
mermaid.helpText: Cmd/Ctrl + Enter to insert · Esc to cancel. See mermaid.js.org for syntax.
